Package neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.liquidphysicalproperties.viscosity

Class LetsouStielViscosity

java.lang.Object
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.PhysicalPropertyMethod
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.liquidphysicalproperties.LiquidPhysicalPropertyMethod
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.liquidphysicalproperties.viscosity.Viscosity
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.liquidphysicalproperties.viscosity.LetsouStielViscosity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, ViscosityInterface, PhysicalPropertyMethodInterface
public class LetsouStielViscosity extends Viscosity
Letsou-Stiel saturated-liquid viscosity estimation from critical constants and acentric factor.

This opt-in pure-component estimator uses the polynomial representation of the Letsou-Stiel tables documented in the ChemSep book, equations 10.158-10.161. It is limited to 0.76 <= T/Tc <= 0.98. It includes neither a pressure correction nor a mixture rule, and does not check saturation. The result is a saturated-liquid estimate even if the supplied liquid phase is compressed. Prefer reference data when available.
